name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or a new feature for this extension
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. E.g., "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How should the extension behave?

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## How will this interact with sensitive permissions?

Since this extension has access to all websites and local files, please specify if this new feature requires any changes to the current permission model or impacts user privacy.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
